messages:
jess: quick check — before I open the PR: are we agreed that streaming deltas will keep the existing 'type' + 'content' events and add an optional 'eos' boolean instead of switching to a separate terminal event?

alex: yes, prefer optional 'eos' on the last delta. simpler for clients that buffer.

mohit: one caveat: for func calls we currently stream partial `arguments` chunks as `func_payload` events. if we add `eos` we need to ensure partial chunks remain valid JSON when concatenated. can we commit to segmentation rules?

jess: good point — proposal: stream `func_payload` as plain text fragments. client concatenates fragments in order. final fragment has "eos": true. server guarantees UTF-8 chunk boundaries (no mid-codepoint splits).

ravi: that avoids JSON reassembly on the client but breaks strict JSON event shape. i worry about existing clients expecting a single `arguments` object. any plan for backward-compat?

jess: compatibility plan: 1) default behavior for 2 weeks after rollout: still send full `arguments` in a single event for >1kb payloads, and `func_payload` fragments only for large streams behind a flag 2) add header `X-Stream-Segmentation: v1` so clients can opt-in 3) deprecate monolithic single-event in 6w with posts to changelog and SDKs updated.

alex: sdk PR will add incremental assembler util — will be behind feature flag. i'll ping when draft is ready.

mohit: minor param question: tool_call object currently has `name` (string) and `arguments` (nullable string). are we making `arguments` nullable OR empty string on early close? wants clarity for schema lints.

jess: keep `arguments` nullable. if we're streaming fragments, top-level `arguments` is null and clients look for `func_payload` fragments. add explicit `streaming: true` boolean in the tool_call envelope so lints don't freak out.

ravi: can we also add `seq` index on fragments? ordering currently relies on delivery order which is fine, but seq helps detect gaps in retries.

mohit: +1 for seq. also note: when using the dedicated routing fallback we might get reorders across proxies — seq is helpful.

jess: ok add `seq` (int) starting at 1 per call. include in spec doc and runtime asserts.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: api-contract-v2 -> staging @ 2024-11-28T02:00:00Z. rollout flag = off by default.

alex: quick PR checklist for reviewers: update convo schema, add streaming assembler util, unit tests for chunk boundaries, docs section about `X-Stream-Segmentation`, and changelog note.

mohit: will review after lunch. if we want to flip flag earlier we should coordinate with ops for metrics.

jess: thanks — i'm going to draft the spec section in the repo. sample streaming fragment payload for the doc:```{
  "event": "func_payload",
  "call_id": "c-1234",
  "seq": 1,
  "data": "{\"partial\": \"...\"}",
  "eos": false
}```

ravi: perfect. also add a small note that clients must sanitize/validate concatenated `data` before eval. security team requested that.

jess: adding that now. i'll tag @security in the PR.``
